{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pulls/22601","id":5006551826,"node_id":"PR_kwDOAORW-88AAAABKmnrEg","html_url":"https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pull/22601","diff_url":"https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pull/22601.diff","patch_url":"https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pull/22601.patch","issue_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/issues/22601","commits_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pulls/22601/commits","review_comments_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pulls/22601/comments","review_comment_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/pulls/comments{/number}","comments_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/issues/22601/comments","statuses_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/statuses/653a11b591bc4cfb17159309c23ccd6d7e7573f4","number":22601,"state":"open","locked":false,"title":"Preserve IME composition ownership across Browser focus transitions","user":{"login":"JHLgithuber","id":88205863,"node_id":"MDQ6VXNlcjg4MjA1ODYz","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/88205863?v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber","html_url":"https://github.com/JHLgithuber","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/JHLgithuber/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"body":"## Problem
Composition completion uses the current input client/focus instead of the field that started it. If focus changes before completion arrives, the original field can lose its preedit and another field can receive the text.

A user reported field migration with Roman and Korean text, while digits stayed in the original field. Actual Chrome/Gboard testing reproduced Korean field migration; synthetic composition events reproduced it with both Latin and Korean text.

## Reproduction
1. Open a Browser app with an empty ordinary TextBox followed by an empty password TextBox.
2. With Chrome/Gboard Korean two-set, type `가나` in the first field, leave composition active, then tap the password field.
3. Expected: `가나` stays in the first field and the password field remains empty. Before the fix, the text moves into the password field; the patched backport retains it in the original field.

The deterministic test starts/updates composition on A with `qaalpha` or `가나`, moves Avalonia focus to B, then sends compositionend from the old DOM editor. Delayed/repeated end events and text↔password/multiline transitions must leave the committed text in A and subsequent input in B independent.

## Fix
Capture the composition's original client and target. Blur the native editor before the original TextBox clears its selection. If blur does not synchronously finish composition, retire the old DOM editor and commit its captured preedit. Delayed events cannot end the new field's composition, and completion for detached or disabled targets is not redirected elsewhere.

Depends on #22600's editor-replacement helper. The incremental diff starts at `2834f722`; the main-targeted diff includes that prerequisite until it merges.

## Testing
- Head `653a11b5`: **13/13 JavaScript tests**. The two added blur/editor-retirement tests fail before the fix; 11 prerequisite tests also pass.
- 11.3.22 backport: **18/18 synthetic cases** covering focus, selection, readonly/disabled targets and delayed events. The focus subset improves from **1/8 to 8/8**.
- Actual emulator Chrome/Gboard: **Korean 6/6, English 3/3**, screen-keyboard test-account login and multiline save/reload passed. In the English comparison, stock lost text in 3/3 cases; the prerequisite input patch already passed 3/3. Exact browser/keyboard build numbers were not recorded for these focus runs.
- Full upstream build: blocked by missing SDK assemblies; build-task and Bun bundle stages passed.
- Gboard completed composition synchronously on blur. The asynchronous fallback has synthetic coverage; final autocorrection differing from the last preedit still needs testing. Additional platform coverage: Firefox, Safari, Samsung/other IMEs and multithreaded WASM.

AI-assisted contribution; code reviewed by the submitting user.
